item.title: Thundercat Announces "Distracted," His First New Album Since 2020
item.description: Thundercat announces "Distracted," his first album since 2020, featuring Tame Impala, Lil Yachty, A$AP Rocky, and more. Out April 3.

item.title: Watch: NAMM 2026 – Pops Magellan Lights Up the Music Man Booth with “Funk Karma”
item.description: Pops Magellan’s NAMM 2026 set with Artur Menezes and Julian Ho had fans wondering again if her groove is from Earth or some deeper corner of the cosmos.

item.title: Neural DSP Unveils Quad Cortex Mini: Full Power, Smaller Footprint
item.description: Neural DSP unveils the Quad Cortex Mini at NAMM 2026, packing full Quad Cortex processing, a 7-inch touchscreen, and massive connectivity into a compact 3.3-pound unit.

item.title: Photo Set: Mike Dirnt and Green Day at the Bass Magazine Awards
item.description: A massive photo set capturing Mike Dirnt’s Lifetime Achievement Award moment and Green Day’s live performance at the Bass Magazine Awards.

item.title: Orange Amplifiers Doubles Up with the OBC215C 2×15 Bass Cabinet
item.description: Orange Amplifiers revives the 2x15 format with the UK-built OBC215C bass cabinet, delivering 800 watts of deep, room-filling low end with Celestion Pulse 15 drivers.

item.title: Richard Bona Trio Captured Live in an Intimate Jazz Setting
item.description: This live trio performance shows Richard Bona leaning into straight ahead jazz with great time, strong interaction, and a relaxed groove.

item.title: Inside Warwick’s Limited Edition Fortress 2026: Masterbuilt and Teambuilt Versions Revealed
item.description: Warwick reveals its Limited Edition Fortress 2026 bass at NAMM, available in Masterbuilt and Teambuilt versions with premium woods, MEC electronics, and Custom Shop craftsmanship.

item.title: Billy Bass Nelson, Founding Architect of P-Funk, Dies at 75
item.description: Billy Bass Nelson, founding bassist of Funkadelic and key architect of early P-Funk, has died at 75. His legacy helped reshape funk music.

item.title: New Mr. Big Video: Billy Sheehan Rips Through “Colorado Bulldog” at Sweetwater Studios
item.description: Billy Sheehan shines in a new Mr. Big live studio performance from Sweetwater Studios playing Colorado Bulldog and The Price You Gotta Pay.

item.title: Weekly Top Ten: Cliff Burton’s New Bass, Fretless Wonders, and NAMM Grooves
item.description: Catch up on No Treble’s most-read stories from Jan 24–30, 2026, including standout NAMM gear, a new Cliff Burton bass, fretless innovations, and unforgettable performances.
